mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (in percent) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as accommodative monetary policy reduces discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the correlation is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% in the prior month, it signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.5, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decrease in industrial production signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * INDPRO) does not have a significant negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 3.0% in the past 6 months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% in the past 6 months), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential construction (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting stronger consumer demand and economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST on 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction (HOUST) falls below 2000 thousand units in the prior month, it signals weak consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST < 2000, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining residential construction (HOUST) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating economic outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * UNRATE) does not have a significant negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO declining below 115 in the past 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced production capacity and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 115 in the past 3 months), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
